name: Axis Real Estate Investment Trust
summary: Axis Real Estate Investment Trust (Axis-REIT), Malaysia's first real estate investment trust. Having been reclassified as an Islamic REIT on 11 December 2008, all acquisitions by Axis-REIT are Shariah compliant. It has a diverse portfolio of 70 properties strategically located in the Klang Valley, Johor, Penang, Pahang, Negeri Sembilan and Kedah as at 30 September 2026. Axis REIT Managers Berhad is the Manager of Axis REIT while RHB Trustees Berhad is the trustee of Axis-REIT. Axis-REIT has a solid industrial space portfolio.
